text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut had finally 
arrived. Marvelous Sunday was even more 
hyped up than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spectators are bewildered by the 
indiscriminate Marvelous appeals, but 
since they don't yet know the potential of 
Marvelous, it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she delivers a great performance, cries 
of "Marvelous!" are sure to echo from 
every corner. The first battle of the 
"World Marvelous Project" begins.
